25: db.exec(`
26:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (

29:     password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
30:     role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
31:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL

33:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (

35:     user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
36:     name TEXT NOT NULL,
37:     description TEXT DEFAULT '',
38:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
39:     FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
40:   );
41: `);
42: 
43: // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
44: 
45: interface User {
46:   id: number;
47:   username: string;
48:   password_hash: string;
49:   role: string;

51: }
52: 
53: interface Item {
54:   id: number;

57:   description: string;
58:   created_at: string;
59: }
60: 
61: interface AuthRequest extends Request {
62:   user?: User;
63: }
64: 
65: // ── Auth Middleware ─────────────────────────────────────────────
66: 
67: function requireAuth(req: AuthRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
68:   const auth = req.headers.authorization;
69:   if (!auth || !auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
70:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'missing authorization header' });
71:     return;
72:   }
73:   try {
74:     const token = auth.split(' ')[1];
75:     const payload = jwt.verify(token, SECRET_KEY) as { user_id: number };
76:     const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(payload.user_id) as User | undefined;
77:     if (!user) {
78:       res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid token' });
79:       return;
80:     }
81:     req.user = user;
82:     next();
83:   } catch {
84:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid or expired token' });
85:   }
86: }
